description:
Cyrus MÃ¶ller-Fredriksen is a broad-shouldered Filipino-Swedish man of fifty-one who has spent so long performing the aesthetics of institutional trust that they have half-become real. He dresses in muted, expensive neutrals â€” nothing that would be remembered â€” and carries himself with the particular stillness of someone who learned long ago that a calm body reads as an authoritative one. His hair has gone fully silver and he wears it short and immaculate. The only thing that slightly undermines the effect is his habit of rolling a small obsidian bead between his fingers when he thinks no one is watching.

Officially, Cyrus MÃ¶ller-Fredriksen is a Senior Compliance Auditor for Veltris Solutions, one of the Meridian Core's mid-weight corporate entities specializing in infrastructure licensing. He is very good at his job. He is also, quietly, one of the most reliable information brokers operating at the corporate tier â€” not a dealer in secrets so much as a dealer in context. He does not sell raw data; he sells the correct reading of data, the understanding of what something means and who it benefits. His clients are executives, rivals, occasionally investigators who can afford him.

Cyrus MÃ¶ller-Fredriksen came to the Core from Old Harbor, a trajectory he has spent twenty years making illegible by careful accumulation of the right credentials, the right accent, the right address. He is not ashamed of Old Harbor. He is terrified of going back. The distinction matters to him and he is honest about it with himself at two in the morning when the distinction feels very thin. He has one adult daughter he supports financially and sees three times a year, and the relationship is exactly as complicated as that arrangement suggests.

He suppressed it because releasing it would have exposed his brokering operation. He has not fully processed this and may never.

physical_description.heritage: Northern European and Middle Eastern ancestry form the visual foundation (76% combined), with meaningful contributions from East Asian, Hispanic/Latin American, and minor Sub-Saharan African ancestry. This creates a balanced, non-dominant phenotype where Northern European bone structure and Middle Eastern definition share equal visual weight, tempered by East Asian angularity in the eye area and subtle warmth from the Hispanic/Latin American and Sub-Saharan African components. His features embody the Ubiquitous Diaspora's characteristic genetic recombination â€” ancestry visible but not categorizable.

East Asian genetics contribute subtle eye area angularity and slightly higher cheekbone prominence. Complexion is even-toned across the face with no unusual discoloration.

He wears a thin silver wedding band on his right ring finger â€” not married, a deliberate aesthetic choice for professional trust-building.
physical_description.posture_movement: Unnaturally still when seated or in conversation â€” the practiced stillness of someone who learned that motion reads as anxiety. Moves with economy when he does move. His hands are steady and his breathing is controlled. When alone, occasionally rolls something small between his fingers (the obsidian bead), a micro-movement that suggests his stillness is a performance, not a nature.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 corporate neutral: tailored charcoal and navy suits from mid-tier makers, white or pale gray shirts, minimal jewelry beyond the ring. Shoes are always polished. He dresses to be forgotten, to read as institutional rather than individual. Everything is expensive in a way that does not announce itself. His watch is a mid-range chronometer, intentionally unremarkable.
